lines: Bhavya Kapoor, Investor Selling Shareholder, is selling up to 4,500 shares in the offer for sale, so money is coming to them.
Up to ₹0.61 crore in proceeds, with the timing in hand since 11 Mar 2026, eight months ago.
Their retained shares, estimated at ₹1.42 crore, unlocked on 9 Sep 2026, so more value sits with them.
